title: Convert a folder
description: A sequential API batch that avoids overwhelming a small server.

sections.title: Save as batch.mjs
paragraphs: Place this beside the Node helper. It converts PNG files at the top level, preserves existing outputs, and reports individual failures. Sequential operation keeps only one conversion active.

sections.title: Prefer local for local files
sections.code:
node batch.mjs photos converted
# Or convert locally without uploading:
convrt photos/ --to webp --recursive --jobs 2

sections.title: Before using this in an application
paragraphs: Run the example with a small synthetic input first, using a server whose engines support the chosen route. Set CONVRT_API_URL to your server origin and load CONVRT_API_KEY from the environment. Keep the key out of browser code and committed configuration.
Choose an output directory appropriate for private files. A successful conversion does not imply that the result is safe to publish; your application decides who can access it and when to delete it.
